accent-1.description: Soft Lilac Tint - Use strictly for surface backgrounds, badge tints, and subtle borders. Low contrast with white; do NOT use for body text.

accent-2.description: Misty Slate Tint - Use for card backgrounds, secondary borders, and subtle separators.

accent-3.description: Neutral Pearl Tint - Use for table row alternations, tags, and surface container fills.

accent-4.description: Subtle Quartz Tint - Use for input borders, hover states, and inactive indicator dots.

accent-5.description: Light Alabaster Tint - Use for delicate section background dividers and pill containers.

text.description: Primary Text & Ink - High-contrast charcoal/black ensuring WCAG AAA (21:1 on white, >12:1 on accent tints).

cta.description: Primary CTA Background - Solid black for unambiguous clarity and WCAG compliance.

ctaText.description: Primary CTA Text - Crisp white on solid black background.

fontFamily.body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
fontFamily.heading: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, Cambria, 'Times New Roman', serif

accessibility.accentNotice: Accents #D4CADF-#D7D1D7 are low-contrast pastels (~1.3:1 with white). They MUST NEVER be used as text or primary CTA backgrounds.
